item.title: Nearly 6,000 transactions completed in first-ever 2-day OFW Serbisyo Caravan in Abha, Saudi Arabia
item.description: A total of 5,932 transactions were successfully processed for 1,298 overseas Filipino workers during the inaugural 2-day “Bagong Bayani ng Mundo” OFW Serbisyo Caravan led by the Department of Migrant Workers (DMW) and Migrant Workers Office–Jeddah (MWO-Jeddah). item.title: 100 cancer patients in Kuwait receive financial assistance through DMW AKSYON fund
item.description: One hundred cancer patients received financial aid from the DMW AKSYON Fund during an awarding ceremony held on December 6 at the Crowne Plaza Hotel in Kuwait. item.title: Abu Dhabi police holds cyber fraud awareness workshops for workers
item.description: Abu Dhabi Police conducted specialized workshops at Al Raha and Laptuel Workers’ Villages to educate laborers about modern cyber fraud schemes. Part of the “Stay Alert” media campaign, the initiative aims to enhance digital security and protect community members from evolving online scams. item.description: A young man who claimed he had verbally agreed to rent a car for Dh350 per day instead of the Dh750 stated in his signed contract was ordered by the Abu Dhabi Commercial Court to pay Dh105,424 for 146 days of unpaid rental fees, including VAT. item.title: Cardinal David: PhilHealth funds must be recovered from perpetrators
item.description: Cardinal Pablo Virgilio David, former president of the Catholic Bishops’ Conference of the Philippines (CBCP), urged President Marcos Jr. and Congress not to cover the P60 billion Supreme Court-ordered return to PhilHealth using the 2026 national budget.
